interpretation.headline: Bounded lexical rerank improves the burned-set retrieval failures and preserves positive-query relevance on fresh2, but fresh2 still exposes three answer-coverage misses and one benign route miss.
interpretation.burned_result_use: The 16-item 2026_08 holdout is burned; its latest rerank run is regression evidence only, not fresh validation.
interpretation.fresh_result_use: Fresh2 is now the current generalization evidence. It was scored once after the bounded lexical fix and is now burned for future tuning decisions.
interpretation.next_step: Diagnose f005/f013 lexical retrieval coverage and f006 answer keyword coverage on a separate debug set, then verify on a successor fresh holdout. f014 route miss produced a good grounded answer via RAG, so it is lower priority than answer-coverage misses.

limitations: Single 18-item same-KB holdout run, not a multi-run statistical study.
Fresh2 was created after inspecting the burned set failure classes; it tests generalization to new questions but is not independent of the chosen failure taxonomy.

The relevance denominator contains only answerable positive queries because run_eval does not perform diagnostic retrieval for unanswerable rows; this run measures retrieval sensitivity, not negative-query specificity.
Direct-control rows f001/f002 used min_hits=1, so their contains_pass result should be read with the recorded answer text, not as a standalone behavioral-proof metric.
Route-only and full-pipeline runs use live Gemini output, so exact answer wording may vary across reruns.
